run_ytvoseval_evaluate: run YTVOSeval evaluate method to compute per video evaluation results for YouTubeVIS dataset
run_ytvoseval_accumulate: run YTVOSeval accumulate method to aggregate per video results into precision and recall arrays
run_ytvoseval_summarize: run YTVOSeval summarize method to compute and display AP and AR summary metrics
create_ytvoseval_instance: create a YTVOSeval object with ground truth and detection COCO API objects for evaluation
review_ytvoseval_compute_iou: review the YTVOSeval computeIoU method that calculates IoU between detection and ground truth mask sequences
